requirement:
The requirements index links to its documented-coverage-gaps subchapter
under {cite}`requirements.test-coverage.index`.
rationale:
The subject requires one thing: the requirements index links to its documented-coverage-gaps subchapter. This applies whether the index is explicitly placed or automatically generated, as `requirements.test-coverage.index` says. The reviewed tests cover each case and assert the link text.

- **Explicit index:** `src/index.rs#mod[tests]/fn[index_shows_evidence_states_and_links_generated_chapters]` builds a book with an explicit `{requirements-index}` marker chapter at `appendix/requirements-index.md`. It asserts that the index content contains `[Documented coverage gaps](requirements-index/coverage.html)`. It also asserts that exactly one "Documented coverage gaps" subchapter exists, with path `appendix/requirements-index/coverage.md` and parent name "Requirements index". The link therefore matches the real subchapter, including when the index is nested in a subdirectory.
- **Automatically generated index:** `src/lib.rs#mod[tests]/fn[definitions_without_a_marker_get_a_default_index_and_detail_pages]` has no marker, so the default index is generated. It asserts that the index content contains `[Documented coverage gaps](requirements-index/coverage.html)`. It also asserts that exactly one coverage subchapter exists, at `requirements-index/coverage.md` under the "Requirements index" parent.
- **Hierarchy variant:** `src/execution_coverage/book.rs#mod[tests]/fn[generated_reports_inherit_the_requirements_index_hierarchy]` uses an index at `reports.md` with a parent chapter, both with and without section numbers. It asserts that the parent content contains `[Documented coverage gaps](reports/coverage.html)`. It also asserts that the coverage chapter's path is `reports/coverage.md` and that it sits among the index's sub_items.

Together these tests cover both the explicit and the automatic index, plus differing index paths and numbering. The assertions check the actual link text and the target chapter's location, so a missing or wrong link would fail them. I found no gap.
